info.name: FBR Digital Invoicing API v1.12
info.description:
Validate and Post Invoice endpoints from PRAL's Technical Specification for DI API v1.12, with the sample values from the document.

Set the `token` variable to the Bearer token issued by PRAL.

Success rule: HTTP 200 AND validationResponse.statusCode == "00" AND every invoiceStatuses[].statusCode == "00". Validation failures still return HTTP 200.

item.name: Sandbox
item.description: Spec sections 4.1.1 and 4.2.1. Sandbox requires scenarioId (SN001..SN028).

request.description: Validates the invoice without issuing an FBR invoice number.

body.raw:
{
  "invoiceType": "Sale Invoice",
  "invoiceDate": "2025-04-21",
  "sellerNTNCNIC": "0786909",
  "sellerBusinessName": "Company 8",
  "sellerProvince": "Sindh",
  "sellerAddress": "Karachi",
  "buyerNTNCNIC": "1000000000000",
  "buyerBusinessName": "FERTILIZER MANUFAC IRS NEW",
  "buyerProvince": "Sindh",
  "buyerAddress": "Karachi",
  "buyerRegistrationType": "Registered",
  "invoiceRefNo": "",
  "scenarioId": "SN001",
  "items": [
    {
      "hsCode": "0101.2100",
      "productDescription": "product Description",
      "rate": "18%",
      "uoM": "Numbers, pieces, units",
      "quantity": 1.0000,
      "totalValues": 0.00,
      "valueSalesExcludingST": 1000.00,
      "fixedNotifiedValueOrRetailPrice": 0.00,
      "salesTaxApplicable": 180.00,
      "salesTaxWithheldAtSource": 0.00,
      "extraTax": 0.00,
      "furtherTax": 120.00,
      "sroScheduleNo": "",
      "fedPayable": 0.00,
      "discount": 0.00,
      "saleType": "Goods at standard rate (default)",
      "sroItemSerialNo": ""
    }
  ]
}
